text:
maya: Heads-up — acme-inc updated their IdP mapping and console preview shows ZERO effective roles after the change. They insist the mapping is identical. anyone see this pattern before?

sam: which preview did they use (console vs API) and can you paste the mapping they applied? :eyes: 

maya: redacted snippet from ticket:
```yaml
mappings:
  - claim: "groups"
    regex: "^redwood-admins$"
    role: "tenant_admin"
```

maya: console preview returned an empty effective_roles array.

dave: i checked auth logs for that tenant — observed several 429s from sso-preview around the same time. looks like throttling caused incomplete evaluation.

sam: current implementation short-circuits on upstream rate limits which means preview returns nothing. we should instead surface which rules were processed and which weren't.

jen: telemetry gap here. we emit SAML auth success/failure but not mapping evaluation failures. propose counters: `saml.mapping.preview_failures` and `saml.mapping.rules_evaluated` with tenant_id and mapping_version tags.

li: UX: the preview pane should include raw claims + a rule-by-rule match table. each rule row should show status (matched/mismatch/error) and a short reason (e.g., missing claim, regex mismatch, eval skipped). current "no roles" is alarmist.

sam: API change suggestion: preview endpoint returns `{ matched_rules: [...], unmatched_reasons: [...], effective_roles: [...] }` so console can show partial results when backend has transient errors. example:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"claims":["redwood-admins"]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sso/preview-map
```

sso-bot: alert: sso-preview service returned 429 for tenant acme-inc at 2024-04-15T14:12:03Z

sam: i'll add `matched_rules` and `unmatched_reasons` fields to the preview response. server will avoid dropping everything on a 429 and will return partial response plus a `warning` string when evaluation was incomplete.

dave: i'll make a separate rate-limit bucket for preview endpoints and loosen limits for preview traffic. will also update 429 payload with human-friendly guidance and a suggestion to retry.

jen: recommend canary rollout behind feature-flag for the preview response shape + rate limit changes. add telemetry for canary vs default behavior.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag/sso-preview-enhancements -> canary (10% tenants).

li: UI mock plan: two-pane preview. left = raw claims JSON; right = match table with rule_id, human_reason, status. when warning present show inline "partial results" state and CTA to retry. default unknown for skipped rules.

maya: action items:
- sam: implement expanded preview payload + warning semantics (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- dave: create preview-specific rate-limit bucket + improve 429 messaging (ETA: +2d)
- jen: add `saml.mapping.preview_failures` metric and tag mapping_version, tenant_id (ETA: +3d)
- li: deliver UI mock + copy adjustments (ETA: next week)
- maya: notify customer with manual-assignment workaround and follow-up when canary is live

sam: decision point — should `matched_rules` include full rule objects (sensitive regexes) or only rule_ids + human_reason? leaning rule_ids + human_reason to avoid leaking patterns. thoughts?

jen: agree with rule_ids + human_reason + a metric-friendly code. redact any sensitive pattern content.

maya: also add the mapping_version to audit logs for preview attempts so support can correlate tickets to exact mapping.

sso-bot: incident-note: SSO preview regression triaged; canary deploy scheduled.
